content.value: Suppose a particular machine requires register-pairs (an even and next odd numbered register) (08) for integer multiplication and division. The even register contains the value of the operand (operand denotes multiplicand/dividend). The instruction has the following format:

$$
O P S o u r c e , D e s t i n a t i o n .
$$
Generate the optimal machine-code sequences for the above expression.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2016
